Original Gangnam Landmark Meshes

These newly authored visualization meshes are dedicated under CC0 1.0:
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

OpenStreetMap-derived geographic footprints and placement remain under ODbL 1.0.
© OpenStreetMap contributors — https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright

Architectural design references: Convexarchitecten GT Tower East and KPF Samsung Seocho.
The photographs, architectural drawings, logos and third-party model files are not bundled.
These are independent simplified exterior reconstructions, not official manufacturer or architect CAD.
Full references, limitations and checksums: manifest.json
